Mid-market SaaS (product analytics + customer success workflow) evaluating Redwood for chat-first support agent assistant. Customer goal: replace brittle macros and 2nd-tier agent lookups with a streaming assistant that can call internal tools (ticket updates, KB lookups, user profile fetch). Primary constraint = latency. Stated SLO: first-token <1.5s 95p for EU and NA; streaming + tool-calling required (Webhooks, structured tool responses).

POC summary (hosted -> potential dedicated):
- Started POC on 2026-02-10 using Hosted API (hosted-eu + hosted-na endpoints). Test workload: 20 concurrent agents, 2.2k conversations/day, median turn length ~120 tokens.
- Implemented streaming with chunked token flush; enabled function/tool call hooks to staging ticketing API.
- Measured first-token times: NA median 1.2s (ok), EU median 1.8s (problematic). Spike analysis: cold-starts and TLS handshake accounted for ~0.2-0.4s; queuing under short bursts added 0.3-0.6s.
- Quality: generations acceptable; tool calling payloads fine but want stronger structured error states.
